def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find top-row cells
    top=[(j,g[0][j]) for j in range(w) if g[0][j]!=0]
    mid=top[len(top)//2][0]
    for j,v in top:
        if j==mid:
            for i in range(h): out[i][j]=v
        else:
            partners=[(i,gg) for i in range(1,h) for jj,gg in enumerate(g[i]) if gg==v]
            if partners:
                pi,pj=partners[0]
                for i in range(pi+1): out[i][j]=v
                for jj in range(j,pj+1 if pj>j else pj-1, 1 if pj>j else -1): out[pi][jj]=v
    return out
